title: pi-tidy-2 → ubuntu/master
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 42a20da..464f357 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,15 @@
+livecd-rootfs (26.10.8) UNRELEASED; urgency=medium
+
+  * Remove references to dead raspi3 subarch
+  * Remove package additions on raspi images that are seeded
+  * Move BINARY_REMOVE_LINUX out of subarch specific sections; it applies to
+    all pre-installed desktops
+  * Always use raspi kernel flavour on raspi images
+  * Remove intel-iot pre-installed settings (unused since 2021), leaving just
+    the live image parts
+
+ -- Dave Jones <dave.jones@canonical.com>  Tue, 25 Aug 2026 10:25:16 +0100
+
 livecd-rootfs (26.10.7) stonking; urgency=medium
 
   * Mount /proc during package reinstall, which is needed for running some of
diff --git a/live-build/auto/config b/live-build/auto/config
index b6f6155..304f903 100755
--- a/live-build/auto/config
+++ b/live-build/auto/config
@@ -449,10 +449,8 @@ case $IMAGEFORMAT in
 				MODEL=pc-amd64 ;;
 			arm64+snapdragon)
 				MODEL=dragonboard ;;
-			arm64+raspi)
-				MODEL=pi-arm64 ;;
-			arm64+raspi3)
-				MODEL=pi3-arm64 ;;
+			arm*+raspi)
+				MODEL="pi-${ARCH}" ;;
 			arm64+tegra)
 				MODEL=tegra ;;
 			arm64+tegra-igx)
@@ -827,6 +825,7 @@ case $PROJECT in
 	ubuntu)
 		case ${SUBPROJECT:-} in
 			desktop-preinstalled)
+				BINARY_REMOVE_LINUX=false
 				add_task install minimal standard ubuntu-desktop
 				case $SUBARCH in
 					raspi)
@@ -840,14 +839,6 @@ case $PROJECT in
 						OPTS="${OPTS:+$OPTS }--ext-resize-blocks=536870912 --ext-block-size=4096"
 						OPTS="${OPTS:+$OPTS }--ext-fudge-factor=15"

-					intel-iot)
-						KERNEL_FLAVOURS='intel-iotg'

-						OPTS="${OPTS:+$OPTS }--ext-resize-blocks=536870912 --ext-block-size=4096"
-						OPTS="${OPTS:+$OPTS }--ext-fudge-factor=15"
-						;;
 					*)
 						## Otherwise HYPERV image options.... *crickets* see the hyperv hook
 						;;
@@ -1264,9 +1255,6 @@ case $PROJECT in
 			amd64*)
 				if [ "${SUBARCH:-}" = "generic" ]; then
 					KERNEL_FLAVOURS=generic
-				elif [ "${SUBARCH:-}" = "intel-iot" ]; then
-					KERNEL_FLAVOURS=intel-iotg
-					OPTS="${OPTS:+$OPTS }--initramfs=none"
 				fi
 				;;
 			riscv64*)
@@ -1363,14 +1351,8 @@ if [ "$PREINSTALLED" != "true" ] && [ "$PASSES_TO_LAYERS" != "true" ] && [ "$LIV
 fi
 
 case "$ARCH${SUBARCH:++$SUBARCH}" in
-	arm64+raspi)
-		# Common configuration for all Raspberry Pi image variants (server,
-		# desktop etc.)
-		KERNEL_FLAVOURS="$SUBARCH"
-		# Most Pi-specific package installation is handled via the seeds in the
-		# per-project/subproject cases above
-		add_package install linux-firmware-raspi pi-bluetooth u-boot-rpi u-boot-tools

+	arm*+raspi)

 		;;

 		# Common configuration for all NVIDIA Tegra image variants
